title: CoreWeave credit stress (H2 2026) - junk-level debt pricing, the Cash Trap Event, and the Core Scientific entanglement
source: Public record + market data, Oct 2026: CoreWeave (CRWV) debt repricing into junk territory - a 2031 unsecured bond yielding in the low-to-mid teens (reported ~15% cost of credit by mid-Oct 2026); CDS priced ~50% five-year default probability (late Jul 2026, techtimes/CDS desks - a sentiment+liquidity+fundamentals signal, NOT a default); ~$51.6B total debt vs ~$5.5B cash, negative net margin, net leverage ~6.8x with 1H adj-EBITDA interest coverage ~2.7x; a dilutive capital stack - a 35M-share at-the-market equity program + a $3.0B private offering of convertible senior notes due 2033 (dilution fears drove the Oct stock drop); CRWV shares down ~25% over six months, gapping -4.4% on Oct 13 and ~-8% on Oct 8 amid an OpenAI-revenue report + an Asian-chip rout; a $2.6B loan whose documents let a serious breach of a backing CUSTOMER contract (service-level/uptime failure giving the customer termination rights) trigger a 'Cash Trap Event' that traps cash and can accelerate repayment (Yahoo Finance/Benzinga, Oct 7 2026); the Core Scientific tie - the Oct 30 2025 CoreWeave-Core Scientific merger TERMINATED after a failed shareholder vote, Core Scientific later revealed (WSJ Dec 15 2025) as the delayed third-party data-center developer behind CoreWeave's lowered 2025 guidance, while CoreWeave funds part of Core Scientific's capex ($129.9M of $389.2M) via colocation agreements; Core Scientific's own 2026 refinancing ($3.3B 7.75% senior secured notes due 2031 on May 6 2026, repaying its term loan + a $1.0B delayed-draw bridge; an Aug 2026 $100M revolver + $500M LC facility). Sources: gurufocus, streetinsider, rollingout, tikr, deepquarry, 247wallst, fxleaders, marketbeat, techtimes, Yahoo Finance, SEC 8-K/10-Q (Core Scientific CIK 1839341). HONESTY/GRADE: the debt-pricing, CDS move, leverage/cash figures, the dilutive raises, the stock moves, the Cash Trap Event CLAUSE, and the Core Scientific merger-collapse + refinancings are FACT; there is NO declared default and NO new formal rating downgrade specifically on Oct 14 2026 - this is MARKET-PRICED credit stress, not a realized credit event, and the 'Cash Trap Event' is a POTENTIAL trigger not a declared one (labeled); the GPU-debt 'doom loop / unsustainable' read is LABELED interpretation carried from CDS-desk/credit commentary; counterpoints (a ~$103.7B backlog, interest covered 2.7x, no liquidity crisis yet, the convertible cutting interest cost) are FACT and recorded so the thread is not one-sided. Overlay/structural edges only; all dollar/credit figures in notes; financial proof core untouched. Companion to spec-oracle-ai-credit-lynchpin (the IG-rated analogue) and spec-ai-compute-credit-risk (the rating-treatment + private-credit layer).

edges.notes: MARKET-PRICED CREDIT STRESS (H2 2026): CoreWeave debt repriced toward junk - a 2031 unsecured bond at low-to-mid-teens yield (~15% cost of credit by mid-Oct 2026) and CDS pricing ~50% five-year default odds (late Jul 2026). ~$51.6B total debt vs ~$5.5B cash, net leverage ~6.8x, 1H adj-EBITDA interest coverage ~2.7x, negative net margin. Funded a dilutive stack: a 35M-share ATM + a $3.0B convertible-senior-notes offering due 2033. This is the pure-play neocloud instance of the same residual/duration/concentration fragility mapped in spec-ai-compute-credit-risk and spec-oracle-ai-credit-lynchpin. FACT: the pricing, leverage, and raises. INTERPRETATION (labeled): the 'GPU-debt doom loop / unsustainable' read (from CDS-desk/credit commentary). NOTE: no declared default and no new formal downgrade on Oct 14 2026 - market-priced stress, not a realized credit event.

CoreWeave's GPU-collateralized, bankruptcy-remote delayed-draw term loans (secured by GPUs + customer contracts) are the ARCHETYPE of the chip-collateral SPV structure - the thing spec-chip-collateral-spv + spec-ai-compute-credit-risk model. A $2.6B loan's documents let a serious breach of a backing CUSTOMER contract (a service-level/uptime failure that gives the customer termination rights) trigger a 'Cash Trap Event' that traps cash and can accelerate repayment - a concrete channel from operational failure to credit acceleration (Yahoo Finance/Benzinga Oct 7 2026). FACT: the clause exists. POTENTIAL (labeled): it is a trigger, NOT a declared event.

ENTANGLEMENT: the CoreWeave-Core Scientific merger TERMINATED on Oct 30 2025 after a failed Core Scientific shareholder vote; Core Scientific was later identified (WSJ Dec 15 2025) as the delayed third-party data-center DEVELOPER behind CoreWeave's lowered 2025 revenue guidance (multiple same-provider sites affected). The dependency runs both ways - CoreWeave funds part of Core Scientific's capex (~$129.9M of $389.2M) via colocation service agreements - so a builder's schedule slip feeds a cloud's guidance cut while the cloud's cash backstops the builder (fact of the merger collapse, the delay attribution, and the colo funding; the two-way-fragility read is labeled).

Core Scientific is a Bitcoin-miner-turned-AI-datacenter host that refinanced heavily in 2026: a $3.3B 7.75% senior-secured-notes offering due 2031 (May 6 2026) repaying its term loan and a $1.0B delayed-draw bridge, plus an Aug 2026 $100M revolver + $500M letter-of-credit facility - a crypto-mining balance sheet reused as AI-datacenter collateral (fact of the refinancings).
